raw_segments.text: I know that a little sensibility and great weakness will produce a strong sexual attachment,
and that reason must cement friendship.
Consequently I allow that more friendship is to be found in the male than the female
world, and that men have a higher sense of justice.
The exclusive affections of women seem indeed to resemble Cotto's most unjust love for
He wished to crush Carthage, not to save Rome, but to promote its vain glory, and in general
